eyebrow: A test that catches a silent sign error
code:
def test_hadamard_on_zero_gives_plus():
  ket0 = np.array([1, 0])
  result = apply_gate(HADAMARD, ket0)
  expected = np.array([1, 1]) / np.sqrt(2)
  assert np.allclose(result, expected)
caption: A sign error in a gate matrix won't crash your program — it'll quietly look plausible and wrong.
